trello.name: Sign venue contract with AV recording guarantee
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Deadline: end of next week. Route the convention center contract (main hall plus two breakout rooms, $18,000, catering separate) through legal review and get it signed. Confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms (main hall and both breakouts), since last year recording was main-hall only and breakout talks were lost.

trello.name: Lock the speaker lineup at nine confirmed
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Deadline: two weeks (by next check-in). Send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of this Friday. If either declines, fill the open slot(s) from the backup list of five names. Commitment is to have the full nine-speaker lineup locked in two weeks so the agenda can be printed.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei
trello.desc: Owner: Bo. Deadline: this week. Chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract; it is needed for the website and the printed program.

trello.name: Draft three-wave email marketing campaign
trello.desc: Owner: Diego. Deadline: draft all three waves this month. Wave 1: agenda announcement sent the day Bo locks the lineup. Wave 2: early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change. Wave 3: final-week push. First wave goes out the day the agenda is live.

trello.name: Update website speaker pages after lineup locks
trello.desc: Owners: Bo and Diego. Trigger: same day the lineup locks. Bo must hand speaker bios and headshots straight to Diego the same day the lineup is locked; Diego must use them to update the speaker landing pages before email wave one goes out. Do not sit on the materials.

trello.name: Approve swag design proofs and place order
trello.desc: Owners: Camille (approval) and Diego (ordering). Camille to review the design proofs in the shared drive today and approve. Once approved, Diego places the order this week for 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers (about $9,200 including rush buffer). Lead time was six weeks last year, so order promptly to avoid missing the event.
